title: Cost-Effectiveness, Budget Impact, and HTA Record
purpose: Summarize cost-effectiveness, affordability, distribution, HTA, reimbursement, adoption conditions, uncertainty, and recommendation.

records.Guidance: Report disaggregated and summary results relative to the comparator.
State the threshold, currency and price year, and probability that the preferred option is cost-effective.
Report eligible volume, uptake, implementation timing, annual cash flow, funding source, and cashable versus non-cashable savings.
Report subgroup outcomes, access, burdens, opportunity costs, mitigation, and residual concern.
Distinguish authorization, external clinical evidence, joint or national assessment, and local evidence.
Identify coverage, coding, tariff, payer, claim, denial, and incentive implications.
Record readiness, procurement, workforce, quality, accreditation, governance, and monitoring prerequisites.
Identify parameters that may change the decision and the value, cost, and timing of further research.
Record adopt, pilot, conditional use, restrict, defer, redesign, reject, or retire, together with conditions and review date.
